jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Agentic Search
jobs.description: The role   We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Agentic Search team, building the search and retrieval infrastructure that powers AI agents and LLM-based applications at scale. This is a hands-on IC role with real ownership. You will take full end-to-end responsibility over a core product area, from defining strategy through shipping and iterating based on real usage data. You will work within a small PM team reporting to the Director of Product, alongside engineering, design, and go-to-market, shaping how AI agents discover, retrieve, and act on web information in real time. The product serves both a developer-facing PLG motion and a growing enterprise customer base, so you will need to be equally comfortable digging into API design and search quality as you are running customer discovery calls and informing competitive positioning. We are looking for someone who can operate as a senior strategic partner, not just an executor, and who has the potential to grow into a principal-level PM over time. You’re welcome to  work hybrid from Tel Aviv, Israel. Your responsibilities will include:   Own a core product area end-to-end: strategy, roadmap, execution, and iteration based on real usage signals and customer feedback. Drive search quality and relevance improvements by working closely with engineering and research to define evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and release criteria. Engage directly with enterprise customers and developer users to validate ideas, understand pain points, and shape product-market fit across both PLG and enterprise motions. Monitor the competitive landscape in agentic search and AI-powered retrieval, identifying shifts, threats, and opportunities that should inform product decisions. Collaborate with go-to-market teams (sales, solutions, growth) to ensure product positioning, ICP definitions, and enablement materials reflect product reality. Contribute to product strategy as a senior voice on a small, high-impact team, challenging assumptions and bringing independent judgment to key decisions. Lead product experiments and rapid iteration cycles, moving from hypothesis to prototype to production with clear success criteria. We expect you to have:   5+ years of product management experience, with a meaningful portion in developer tools, API platforms, or search and retrieval infrastructure. Track record of shipping products in fast-moving markets, working closely with engineering and design from concept through launch and iteration. Strong understanding of LLMs, AI agents, and how search and retrieval systems fit into agentic workflows. Hands-on technical background is a strong plus. Degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, with the ability to engage deeply with technical architecture and tradeoffs. Comfortable operating in ambiguity: you can context-switch between strategic thinking and tactical execution without losing the thread. Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and drive alignment without formal authority. Excellent written and verbal communication: you can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and business stakeholders. It will be an added bonus if you have:   Experience in search, information retrieval, NLP, or adjacent domains. Background in API-first or developer-platform businesses with both PLG and enterprise motions. Leadership experience in a high-growth technology company, especially post-acquisition or startup-within-a-larger-org environments. People management or mentoring experience (building the skills of other PMs). Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
